description: Colour literals intentionally left in the public/shared files no other workstream owned (contract 10.4 rule 5). The scan test (ws8-js-scan.test.js) fails on any literal in an owned file that is neither here nor a mode-agnostic black shadow (X6).

legend.WS8-A: Intentional dark surface that stays dark in both modes (the OAuth consent card, media letterbox).
legend.X2: Content rendered inside an iframe (a separate document, so CSS variables cannot reach it); values are the light-baseline fallbacks of tokens resolved at runtime.
legend.X5: Third-party brand marks and fixed brand colours (Solana tints).
